name: Set a Consistent Sleep Schedule
equipment: A notebook or phone reminder to set a fixed bedtime
instructions: Pick a bedtime and wake-up time you can hold seven days a week, weekends included -- consistency matters more than the exact hours you choose.
Work backward from your wake time to give yourself a genuine 7-8 hour window in bed.
Set a phone alarm 30 minutes before your target bedtime as a "start winding down" cue, not just a wake-up alarm.
Follow along with tonight's wind-down meditation to end the day on the same cue your body will learn to recognize.
